source.why_this_release: register v6.2 P3: Buch ran PANTHER 16.0 GO-slim enrichment; the fallback is that tool's own gene -> GO-slim annotation as served (R12 logic), the terms those of PANTHERGOslim.obo (pinned) the printed labels reach by the name rule

rule: PANTHER 16.0's gene -> GO-slim annotation as served: the genes whose PTHR16.0_human row lists the term (column BP; no propagation added); HGNC id -> HGNC (else Ensembl / Entrez / UniProt id, else the symbol); the fallback of Buch's GO-slim cells: used only if MOESM3 (source 1, under G1) holds no list meeting the source-1 criterion (register 1.6, v6.1 Q1 as revised by v6.2 P1 / P2 / P6, v6.3 O1-O4 / O6 and v6.4 N1-N4): a carrier list qualifies only if the carrier presents it as the set's membership used as input to the enrichment -- a list of gene symbols under a heading naming the set (the cell's pinned name alternatives; rival names win when more specific), its sheet name, table title, caption or its own title carrying input wording; refused if its own title or the caption carries result wording or names one of the paper's maps, subgroups or cohorts (leading edge, core, driving, top, PLS, loading, weight, enriched, decoded, overlap or hit genes; '_' and '.' read as spaces), or if its own title, the caption or any column title of its table carries statistics wording, or if any cell of its sheet (docx / pdf: its table and caption) other than the lists' own genes carries statistics, result or map wording (v6.4 N1); where the paper prints a set size the list length must equal it; exactly one qualifying list, else the else branch (carrier_tests.json source1_lists, cells keyed by cell id; carrier_test.py source1 --cell, one run per pathway for a family); and (v6.5) the list must be corroborated: Jaccard >= .80 with the cell's pinned external definition (in the class universe, by HGNC gene), else its length equal to the cell's printed size; a cell with neither is never corroborated
